column1: # The v0.12 case-study corpus pins, resolved to full commit SHAs.
# One row per config in this directory: repository, the 40-character commit
# the study ran against (case_study_repos.md lists 10-character prefixes),
# and the config file. Resolved through the GitHub API on 2026-10-24; every
# SHA a config's header names matches its row. tokio-rs/tokio, the
# calibration repo, has no row: its config is examples/tokio-rs-tokio/ and
# tracks upstream rather than the pin. The v0.23 corpus stratum
# (docs/design/v0.23/corpus-stratum.md) adds its rows, resolved the same way
